rate_limit: تم الوصول إلى الحد الأقصى. نفّذ `docker login` على المضيف.
cleanup_none: ✅ لم يتم العثور على صور غير مستخدمة.
selfupdate_restarting: جارٍ بدء التحديث الذاتي... سيكون البوت غير متصل لفترة قصيرة.
selfupdate_failed_id: ❌ فشل التحديث الذاتي: لم يتم العثور على معرّف الحاوية.
selfupdate_failed_container: ❌ فشل التحديث الذاتي: لم يتم العثور على الحاوية.
pin_added: 📌 تم تثبيت `{name}` — سيتم تخطيه عند التحديث.
web_auto_cleanup_hint: بعد كل تحديث تلقائي ناجح، يتم إزالة الصور غير المستخدمة الأقدم من 24 ساعة.
web_cleanup_grace_hours_hint: إزالة الصور غير المستخدمة لهذه المدة على الأقل فقط. أعلى = أكثر أمانًا.
web_cleanup_backup_days_hint: مدة الاحتفاظ بأرشيفات tar للنسخ الاحتياطية.
web_cleanup_backup_local_only_hint: يحفظ الصور المبنية محليًا (بدون digest من السجل) كأرشيف tar قبل الحذف.
web_disk_warn_percent_hint: Notify when disk usage exceeds this percent (one warning per day max).
web_disk_warn_auto_cleanup_hint: Run cleanup automatically when the warning threshold is crossed.
web_quiet_hours_hint: Auto-notifications during this window are dropped (manual command replies always go through). Leave both empty to disable.
web_windows_intro: Restrict auto-updates to specific time-of-day and weekday windows. Containers without a window entry update without restriction.
web_windows_days_hint: Leave all unchecked to allow every weekday.
web_major_pending_intro: These containers have a pending major-version bump. Major updates can break configs — confirm or skip.
web_settings_intro: Configure how Docksentry checks for, applies, and notifies about updates. Changes here override the corresponding environment variables and persist across restarts.
web_cron_help: 5-field cron expression (minute hour day month weekday). Default 0 18 * * * = daily at 18:00.
web_excluded_help: Comma-separated list of container names to skip during checks (e.g. 'plex,nextcloud'). Useful for containers you only want to update manually.
web_debug_help: Send detailed update-check logs to Telegram on every run. Useful for diagnosing why a container is or isn't being seen.
web_auto_selfupdate_help: When on, Docksentry pulls and applies its own image update on every scheduled cron tick. Off = self-update only on demand via /selfupdate or the maintenance button.
web_updates_tab_hint: Per-container auto-update flags, pin/unpin, and the major-confirm toggle live on the Status page — pick which containers get treated which way there.
web_topic_id_help: Optional. Set this to send Telegram messages to a specific topic/thread inside a forum-style group, instead of the general topic.
web_discord_help: Optional. Set to a Discord channel webhook URL to mirror updates as rich embeds in Discord. Find it under: Server Settings → Integrations → Webhooks.
web_webhook_help: Optional. Generic JSON POST endpoint — works with Ntfy, Gotify, Home Assistant, n8n, etc. Receives all events as JSON payloads.
web_maintenance_intro: Manual one-shot actions. Each runs in the background and reports the result via the configured notification channels.
web_maintenance_explain: Image Cleanup removes unused Docker images older than {grace}h. With Backup local-only enabled, locally-built images are saved as tarballs in {dir} and kept for {days} days. Self-Update pulls the latest Docksentry image and recreates this container.
web_confirm_cleanup: Run docker image prune now? Unused images older than the grace period will be deleted.
web_confirm_selfupdate: Self-update Docksentry? The container will pull the latest image and restart itself — this Web UI will be briefly unavailable.
web_info_credentials_hint: Bot Token and Chat ID can only be set via environment variables. WEB_PORT and WEB_PASSWORD are also env-only — changing them in a UI you're using right now would lock you out.
web_badge_update_tt: An update is available — open the row's update button or use Bulk Update.
web_badge_auto_tt: Auto-update enabled — runs on the next scheduled tick.
web_badge_major_tt: Major-update confirmation enabled — major version bumps require manual confirm.
web_bulk_pin_tt: Pin all selected — they'll be skipped on update checks.
web_container_detail_hint: This page will host per-container history, logs, and per-container update settings (window, major-confirm, auto-update). For now use the Status page actions.
web_history_empty_hint: Updates will be recorded here once they happen.
